translations.web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
translations.bsb: Then He placed His hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God.
translations.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
translations.asv: And he laid his hands upon her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
